title: Deposit Instalments Printed Against Each Private Event & Banquet Services Package
content:
Deposits on Private Event & Banquet Services are taken in up to two instalments, and the percentages and windows below are those printed against each package.

| Package | First deposit, per cent of the estimated event value | First deposit due, calendar days after the booking is confirmed | Second deposit, per cent of the estimated event value | Second deposit due, calendar days before the event | Deposits returnable until, calendar days before the event |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 15 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 7 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 25 | 10 | 25 | 14 | 21 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 30 | 14 | 30 | 21 | 45 |
| Gala Reception Package | 35 | 14 | 40 | 30 | 90 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 40 | 21 | 35 | 45 | 120 |

The first column of percentages is the first deposit taken on confirmation, as a percentage of the estimated event value, and the third is the second deposit taken before the event on the same basis. The due columns are the calendar days after the booking is confirmed by which the first deposit is due and the calendar days before the event by which the second is due. The last column is the calendar days before the event up to which deposits are still returnable.

Two packages print a second deposit percentage of 0, the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package. The largest second instalment on the schedule is 40 per cent, on the Gala Reception Package, which is the only package whose second instalment exceeds its first; on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package the first instalment of 40 per cent is the larger of the two and the second stands at 35 per cent.

The returnable window widens sharply with the size of the room: 2 days on the Meeting Room Refreshment Package, 7 on the Boardroom Reception Package, 21 on the Conference Day Delegate Package, 45 on the Seated Banquet Package, 90 on the Gala Reception Package and 120 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package.
